COLUMN CROSS-CHECK: three level-1 records agree for all 7 items -- ES2973 DATA LIST positions 48..54; ES2973 VARIABLE LABELS (/P5A01 'El País', /P5A02 'El Mundo', /P5A03 'La Vanguardia', /P5A04 'ABC', /P5A05 'Gratuitos (no deportivos)', /P5A06 'Otros periódicos regionales/locales (no deportivos)', /P5A07 'Otros periódicos (no deportivos)'); and the printed questionnaire grid rows with column markers (48)..(54). All asserted in .cache/spain_2012_reality_press/build.R. Labels name the outlet, so no two can be swapped without being self-evident. TEXT (text_source=study_materials): item_text is the questionnaire's grid-row label, which equals the ES2973 variable label verbatim for all 7 (line-break hyphens in the scan joined: 'depor-tivos' -> 'deportivos', 'perió-dicos' -> 'periódicos'). P.5a's shared stem goes in instructions: 'Y, en una semana normal, ¿cuántos días lee los siguientes periódicos que le voy a mencionar (sea en papel o a través de Internet)?'. The questionnaire PDFs are image-only scans; wording read visually from 250-dpi renders of page 2 (.cache/spain_2012_reality_press/crop_p5stem_A/B.png, crop_p5a_A/B.png) -- spot-check advisable. Versions A and B print P.5 and P.5a identically (compared side by side; FT2973 says the versions differ only in P.9, 12, 15, 21, 24, 26, 29). Dropped from instructions: 'P.5a.' numbering and the interviewer direction '(MOSTRAR TARJETA B).' (sibling precedent). OPTIONS: ES2973 VALUE LABELS (identical on P5A01..P5A07, asserted) label only 0 'Ninguno' and 7 'Todos' (plus 8 N.S., 9 N.C., -99 No procede); the questionnaire grid header prints 'Ninguno 1 2 3 4 5 6 Todos'. The respondent-facing show card TARJETA B (text layer of tarjetas2973tipoA.pdf and tipoB.pdf, identical) prints every point: '0 NINGUNO, 1 DÍA, 2 DÍAS, 3 DÍAS, 4 DÍAS, 5 DÍAS, 6 DÍAS, 7 TODOS'. SOURCE CHOICE: option_text ships the card's words for resp 1..6 ('1 día', '2 días', ... '6 días' -- the card's numeral plus its printed word 'DÍA/DÍAS', not a number padded in by IRW) and the value labels' mixed case 'Ninguno'/'Todos' for 0/7; the card's all-capitals were rendered in sentence case (the media sibling batch_575 likewise preferred TARJETA A's words, in value-label case, as what the respondent saw). All 7 items use all 8 levels. FILTER: P.5a is asked only of respondents who read a newspaper at all (P.5 codes 1-4; P.5 = 5 'Nunca' -> 'Pasar a P.6'). In DA2973 cols 48-54 are blank for 1106 records (1101 P.5=Nunca + 5 P.5=N.C.), and the .do leaves those missing; 0 of the 1850 live ids have P.5 outside 1..4. 0 'Ninguno' is a valid scale point (a newspaper reader who does not read that title). SENTINELS: the .do sets 8/9 to missing; raw 8/9 per item p5a01..07 = 6/24, 7/32, 6/36, 6/45, 7/33, 4/18, 6/31. REBUILD: DA2973 (2962 records, width 392, ESTUDIO=2973, id = row number) cols 48..54 minus blanks and 8/9, cov_sex col 160, cov_age cols 384-385 (99 -> NA) reproduces the live table exactly: 12731 rows both, 1850 ids both, 0 only-live / 0 only-rebuilt id-item keys, 0 duplicate keys, 0 resp / 0 cov_age mismatches, cov_sex 6872 Hombre / 5859 Mujer all on the diagonal (.cache/spain_2012_reality_press/rebuild.R; live read from the local irw cache populated by table_context.R). Live item means (days/week): El País 1.29, El Mundo 0.83, La Vanguardia 0.59, ABC 0.42, gratuitos 0.97, regional/local 2.74, otros 0.83 -- coherent (regional/local press most read; Barcelona-based La Vanguardia low in a national sample). STEP 3b: dictionary Description ('Weekly reading frequency of newspapers') and the .do header ('press (P5A01 to P5A07) 0-7 days per week reading each of seven newspaper types') describe P.5a; 7 items, resp 0..7 match; no mismatch. validate_items.R --table-sets PASS (7 items, resp 0..7; 56 rows). language=Spanish; translation_source=machine_translation (CIS publishes Estudio 2973 in Spanish only; all _translated columns are English written by IRW; newspaper titles left untranslated; issues-page line owed once live). RIGHTS: applied the existing instrument_rights_register.csv CIS row (verdict allow, all CIS survey years, irw#2381); originator is CIS. No register row written.
public_note: Codes are days per week (0 = none, 7 = every day); only respondents who said they read a newspaper at all were asked, so non-readers have no rows, and don't-know/no-answer are stored as missing; English is IRW machine translation of the Spanish-only CIS questionnaire
